title: Shared Refusal Vocabulary v1
description: Canonical refusal vocabulary that maps all known v1 refusal codes across surfaces into shared refusal classes. This is a normalization layer — domain schemas keep their own codes; the vocabulary adds shared classification. Content-light: no raw tokens, paths, secrets, prompts, or private file contents.
